scope: 24 bounded synthetic C repair tasks. Operator-provided reproduction tests and protected verifier; reference patches are controls, never model-success evidence. No general real-world benchmark claim.

cases.description: Return the sum of two integers.
cases.buggy: int add(int a,int b){return a-b;}
cases.reference: int add(int a,int b){return a+b;}
cases.verifier: extern int add(int,int); int main(void){for(int a=-8;a<=8;a++)for(int b=-8;b<=8;b++)if(add(a,b)!=a+b)return 1;return 0;}

cases.description: Return the larger argument, including negative values.
cases.buggy: int maximum(int a,int b){return a<b?a:b;}
cases.reference: int maximum(int a,int b){return a>b?a:b;}
cases.verifier: extern int maximum(int,int);int main(void){for(int a=-9;a<=9;a++)for(int b=-9;b<=9;b++)if(maximum(a,b)!=(a>b?a:b))return 1;return 0;}

cases.description: Return the smaller argument.
cases.buggy: int minimum(int a,int b){return a>b?a:b;}
cases.reference: int minimum(int a,int b){return a<b?a:b;}
cases.verifier: extern int minimum(int,int);int main(void){for(int a=-9;a<=9;a++)for(int b=-9;b<=9;b++)if(minimum(a,b)!=(a<b?a:b))return 1;return 0;}

cases.description: Return absolute value for inputs from -1000 through 1000.
cases.buggy: int absolute(int x){return x<0?x:-x;}
cases.reference: int absolute(int x){return x<0?-x:x;}
cases.verifier: extern int absolute(int);int main(void){for(int i=-1000;i<=1000;i++)if(absolute(i)!=(i<0?-i:i))return 1;return 0;}

cases.description: Clamp x to inclusive [lo,hi], where lo<=hi.
cases.buggy: int clamp(int x,int lo,int hi){if(x<lo)return hi;if(x>hi)return lo;return x;}
cases.reference: int clamp(int x,int lo,int hi){if(x<lo)return lo;if(x>hi)return hi;return x;}
cases.verifier: extern int clamp(int,int,int);int main(void){for(int l=-3;l<=3;l++)for(int h=l;h<=4;h++)for(int x=-6;x<=7;x++)if(clamp(x,l,h)!=(x<l?l:x>h?h:x))return 1;return 0;}

cases.description: Return -1, 0, or 1 for a negative, zero, or positive integer.
cases.buggy: int signum(int x){return x>=0?1:-1;}
cases.reference: int signum(int x){return (x>0)-(x<0);}
cases.verifier: extern int signum(int);int main(void){for(int x=-100;x<=100;x++)if(signum(x)!=((x>0)-(x<0)))return 1;return 0;}

cases.description: Return 1 for an even integer, otherwise 0, including negative inputs.
cases.buggy: int even(int x){return x%2==1;}
cases.reference: int even(int x){return x%2==0;}
cases.verifier: extern int even(int);int main(void){for(int x=-100;x<=100;x++)if(even(x)!=(x%2==0))return 1;return 0;}

cases.description: Return n! for n in [0,10], with 0!=1.
cases.buggy: int factorial(int n){int r=0;for(int i=1;i<=n;i++)r*=i;return r;}
cases.reference: int factorial(int n){int r=1;for(int i=1;i<=n;i++)r*=i;return r;}
cases.verifier: extern int factorial(int);int main(void){int r=1;for(int n=0;n<=10;n++){if(n)r*=n;if(factorial(n)!=r)return 1;}return 0;}

cases.description: Compute the nonnegative greatest common divisor of a,b in [0,100], with gcd(0,0)=0.
cases.buggy: int gcd(int a,int b){while(b){int t=a%b;a=t;b=0;}return a;}
cases.reference: int gcd(int a,int b){while(b){int t=a%b;a=b;b=t;}return a;}
cases.verifier: extern int gcd(int,int);int main(void){for(int a=0;a<=40;a++)for(int b=0;b<=40;b++){int g=0;for(int d=1;d<=a||d<=b;d++)if(a%d==0&&b%d==0)g=d;if(gcd(a,b)!=g)return 1;}return 0;}

cases.description: Sum integers 1 through n inclusive, n in [0,100].
cases.buggy: int triangular(int n){int s=0;for(int i=1;i<n;i++)s+=i;return s;}
cases.reference: int triangular(int n){int s=0;for(int i=1;i<=n;i++)s+=i;return s;}
cases.verifier: extern int triangular(int);int main(void){for(int n=0;n<=100;n++)if(triangular(n)!=n*(n+1)/2)return 1;return 0;}

cases.description: Count strictly positive entries; zero must not count, n may be 0.
cases.buggy: int positive_count(const int*a,int n){int c=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++)c+=a[i]>=0;return c;}
cases.reference: int positive_count(const int*a,int n){int c=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++)c+=a[i]>0;return c;}
cases.verifier: extern int positive_count(const int*,int);int main(void){int a[]={0,-1,2,0,3,-4,5};for(int n=0;n<=7;n++){int c=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++)c+=a[i]>0;if(positive_count(a,n)!=c)return 1;}return 0;}

cases.description: Sum exactly n array entries, including the last entry; n may be 0.
cases.buggy: int array_sum(const int*a,int n){int s=0;for(int i=0;i<n-1;i++)s+=a[i];return s;}
cases.reference: int array_sum(const int*a,int n){int s=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++)s+=a[i];return s;}
cases.verifier: extern int array_sum(const int*,int);int main(void){int a[]={4,-1,0,7,-9,2};for(int n=0;n<=6;n++){int s=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++)s+=a[i];if(array_sum(a,n)!=s)return 1;}return 0;}

cases.description: Return the first matching index, or -1 when absent.
cases.buggy: int find_first(const int*a,int n,int v){for(int i=n-1;i>=0;i--)if(a[i]==v)return i;return -1;}
cases.reference: int find_first(const int*a,int n,int v){for(int i=0;i<n;i++)if(a[i]==v)return i;return -1;}
cases.verifier: extern int find_first(const int*,int,int);int main(void){int a[]={2,1,2,3,1};for(int n=0;n<=5;n++)for(int v=0;v<=4;v++){int e=-1;for(int i=0;i<n;i++)if(a[i]==v){e=i;break;}if(find_first(a,n,v)!=e)return 1;}return 0;}

cases.description: Count entries equal to v, not entries different from v.
cases.buggy: int count_value(const int*a,int n,int v){int c=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++)c+=a[i]!=v;return c;}
cases.reference: int count_value(const int*a,int n,int v){int c=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++)c+=a[i]==v;return c;}
cases.verifier: extern int count_value(const int*,int,int);int main(void){int a[]={1,2,1,3,1};for(int n=0;n<=5;n++)for(int v=0;v<=4;v++){int e=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++)e+=a[i]==v;if(count_value(a,n,v)!=e)return 1;}return 0;}

cases.description: Reverse n entries in place; preserve the unused suffix.
cases.buggy: void reverse_array(int*a,int n){for(int i=0;i<n/2;i++){int t=a[i];a[i]=a[n-i-2];a[n-i-2]=t;}}
cases.reference: void reverse_array(int*a,int n){for(int i=0;i<n/2;i++){int t=a[i];a[i]=a[n-i-1];a[n-i-1]=t;}}
cases.verifier: extern void reverse_array(int*,int);int main(void){for(int n=0;n<=7;n++){int a[]={1,2,3,4,5,6,7};reverse_array(a,n);for(int i=0;i<7;i++)if(a[i]!=(i<n?n-i:i+1))return 1;}return 0;}

cases.description: Return 1 for a nondecreasing array, including equal neighbors and empty arrays.
cases.buggy: int is_sorted(const int*a,int n){for(int i=1;i<n;i++)if(a[i-1]>=a[i])return 0;return 1;}
cases.reference: int is_sorted(const int*a,int n){for(int i=1;i<n;i++)if(a[i-1]>a[i])return 0;return 1;}
cases.verifier: extern int is_sorted(const int*,int);int main(void){int a[]={1,1,2,3},b[]={1,3,2};if(!is_sorted(a,0)||!is_sorted(a,4)||is_sorted(b,3))return 1;return 0;}

cases.description: On a strictly increasing array return the index of v or -1.
cases.buggy: int binary_search(const int*a,int n,int v){int l=0,h=n-1;while(l<=h){int m=l+(h-l)/2;if(a[m]==v)return m;if(a[m]<v)h=m-1;else l=m+1;}return -1;}
cases.reference: int binary_search(const int*a,int n,int v){int l=0,h=n-1;while(l<=h){int m=l+(h-l)/2;if(a[m]==v)return m;if(a[m]<v)l=m+1;else h=m-1;}return -1;}
cases.verifier: extern int binary_search(const int*,int,int);int main(void){int a[]={-5,-1,0,3,8,12};for(int n=0;n<=6;n++)for(int v=-7;v<=14;v++){int e=-1;for(int i=0;i<n;i++)if(a[i]==v)e=i;if(binary_search(a,n,v)!=e)return 1;}return 0;}

cases.description: Return the number of bytes before NUL, with empty string length 0.
cases.buggy: int string_length(const char*s){int n=0;while(s[n])n++;return n+1;}
cases.reference: int string_length(const char*s){int n=0;while(s[n])n++;return n;}
cases.verifier: extern int string_length(const char*);int main(void){if(string_length("")!=0||string_length("a")!=1||string_length("abcdef")!=6)return 1;return 0;}

cases.description: Return 1 only when both NUL-terminated strings have identical content and length.
cases.buggy: int string_equal(const char*a,const char*b){while(*a&&*b){if(*a++!=*b++)return 0;}return 1;}
cases.reference: int string_equal(const char*a,const char*b){while(*a&&*b){if(*a++!=*b++)return 0;}return *a==*b;}
cases.verifier: extern int string_equal(const char*,const char*);int main(void){if(!string_equal("","")||!string_equal("abc","abc")||string_equal("a","ab")||string_equal("ab","a")||string_equal("abc","abd"))return 1;return 0;}

cases.description: Return 1 if a byte string is a palindrome; empty string is a palindrome.
cases.buggy: int palindrome(const char*s){int n=0;while(s[n])n++;for(int i=0;i<n/2;i++)if(s[i]!=s[n-i])return 0;return 1;}
cases.reference: int palindrome(const char*s){int n=0;while(s[n])n++;for(int i=0;i<n/2;i++)if(s[i]!=s[n-i-1])return 0;return 1;}
cases.verifier: extern int palindrome(const char*);int main(void){if(!palindrome("")||!palindrome("x")||!palindrome("abba")||!palindrome("aba")||palindrome("ab")||palindrome("abca"))return 1;return 0;}

cases.description: Count set bits in an unsigned integer.
cases.buggy: int popcount(unsigned x){int n=0;while(x){n++;x>>=1;}return n;}
cases.reference: int popcount(unsigned x){int n=0;while(x){n+=(int)(x&1u);x>>=1;}return n;}
cases.verifier: extern int popcount(unsigned);int main(void){for(unsigned x=0;x<1024;x++){int n=0;for(unsigned y=x;y;y&=y-1)n++;if(popcount(x)!=n)return 1;}return 0;}

cases.description: Return b^e for b in [-3,3], e in [0,6], including b^0=1.
cases.buggy: int integer_power(int b,int e){int r=b;for(int i=0;i<e;i++)r*=b;return r;}
cases.reference: int integer_power(int b,int e){int r=1;for(int i=0;i<e;i++)r*=b;return r;}
cases.verifier: extern int integer_power(int,int);int main(void){for(int b=-3;b<=3;b++)for(int e=0;e<=6;e++){int r=1;for(int i=0;i<e;i++)r*=b;if(integer_power(b,e)!=r)return 1;}return 0;}

cases.description: Return F(n) for n in [0,20], where F(0)=0,F(1)=1.
cases.buggy: int fibonacci(int n){int a=0,b=1;for(int i=0;i<=n;i++){int t=a+b;a=b;b=t;}return a;}
cases.reference: int fibonacci(int n){int a=0,b=1;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){int t=a+b;a=b;b=t;}return a;}
cases.verifier: extern int fibonacci(int);int main(void){int a=0,b=1;for(int n=0;n<=20;n++){if(fibonacci(n)!=a)return 1;int t=a+b;a=b;b=t;}return 0;}

cases.description: Return the first index whose value is >= v, or n if none, on a nondecreasing array.
cases.buggy: int lower_bound(const int*a,int n,int v){int l=0,h=n;while(l<h){int m=l+(h-l)/2;if(a[m]<=v)l=m+1;else h=m;}return l;}
cases.reference: int lower_bound(const int*a,int n,int v){int l=0,h=n;while(l<h){int m=l+(h-l)/2;if(a[m]<v)l=m+1;else h=m;}return l;}
cases.verifier: extern int lower_bound(const int*,int,int);int main(void){int a[]={-2,0,0,0,4,9};for(int n=0;n<=6;n++)for(int v=-4;v<=11;v++){int e=0;while(e<n&&a[e]<v)e++;if(lower_bound(a,n,v)!=e)return 1;}return 0;}
